# FireRed reference fixtures

Run `uv run crates/tafrigh/tests/fixtures/firered/generate.py` from the repository root. The script verifies the pinned official feature-code and timestamp-code hashes, runs FireRed's numpy/Kaldi frontend and cached ONNX model, and writes features, probabilities, and sample-accurate spans. It uses 20-frame inference calls; Rust uses 128-frame calls. The matched timestamp policy is onset 0.4, exit 0.25, minimum speech 500 ms, minimum silence 300 ms, and padding 250 ms. Fixtures cover 15 s unmerged and 30 s merged chunks. The long case repeats the short recitation five times without resetting state; its probabilities and spans are saved without duplicating audio or features.

`speech` reuses the existing `../short.s16le` fixture. `recitation.s16le` contains the first eight seconds of [Al Fatiha in Hamzah al-Kufi qiraat style or harf](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Al_Fatiha_in_Hamzah_al-Kufi_qiraat_style_or_harf.ogg), recorded and uploaded by PeaceSeekers on 2025-03-29 under [CC0 1.0](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/). The original Ogg file has SHA-256 `8de3c59f2b7add03b8534c783f67521dafd3ec6e6f292962fba7aa71005b8a96`; conversion used `ffmpeg -i recitation.ogg -t 8 -ac 1 -ar 16000 -f s16le recitation.s16le`. The corpus recordings used for accuracy benchmarks are not redistributed here.

`constant.features.f32` checks DC removal and the logarithm floor against the official frontend. All `.f32` files are little-endian float32; features are in frame-major order with 80 bins. Audio hashes, sample counts, frame counts, and full reference frontend settings are in `golden.json`. Normal tests read only committed files, without Python or network access.
